newsitem.title: INDIA: India, Switzerland sign investment protection pact.
newsitem.headline: India, Switzerland sign investment protection pact.

text.p: India and Switzerland on Friday signed an investment promotion and protection treaty that covers intellectual property rights and includes an elaborate dispute resolution mechanism, the Finance Ministry said.

The 10-year pact, which must be ratified by both nations, was signed by Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram and Swiss Federal Councillor for Economic Affairs Jean-Pascal Delamuraz, the ministry said in a statement.

"The agreement will serve as a major catalyst for investment flows from both countries," the statement said. "The agreement will impart a new momentum to the continuing Indo-Swiss economic relations, particularly mutual investments."
